description: facade-spec/1 fields -> GDL parameters of concrete Archicad library parts (ADR-001 I2). Every entry was found with GetGDLParametersOfElements on a placed sample and checked live (write -> read back, 3D geometry). Nothing here is guessed; parts not listed are refused by systems.py.

verified.library: AC29 CZE template library, Door 27 / Window 27 family

dsl.write:
param -> '$v' (spec value), '$surface' (surface attribute index of the spec value, a surface name), '$v+param:

' (value plus the current value of GDL parameter p), or an object mapping str(spec value) -> param value
dsl.read: {'param': p} | {'param': p, 'map': {str(param value): spec value}} | {'param': p, 'minus_param': q} | {'param': p, 'gt': x} (true when > x) | {'count_nonempty': [p, ...]} | {'param': p, 'surface': true} (index -> surface name)
dsl.fixed: value the library part has by itself (no write); the read rule still checks it
dsl.unsupported: the part cannot carry this field; a spec value different from 'default' is reported as an exception, never silently passed

door.system_params_note: gs_nominal_size 1 = width/height are the wall hole (the masonry opening seen on the facade); gs_reveal_type_int 2 = 'No Reveal' (the favourites default 'No Reveal - Edge' laps the wall 4-6 cm over the frame, so the hole on the facade would be smaller than the photo); gs_bAutoTurnIn false = the outside plaster skin of a composite wall is not turned into the reveal (otherwise the hole on the facade is 2 cm smaller on three sides, measured 2026-10-19) - simplification: the photo edge is taken as the masonry opening

reveal.note: refSide true = wall inset measured from the reference (outside) side of the wall: frame outer face at w = -reveal (calibrated 0 / 0.10 / 0.25 m on a basic wall, 2026-10-19). refSide false measures from the inside face - the I1 doors sat at the inside face. On a COMPOSITE wall the favourites measure from the core (revealDepthLocation = Core, not settable through Tapir): the sent offset is reduced by the skins outside the core; AC_wido_sill reads the inset from the wall face.

window.system_params_note: as for doors: no reveal edge, and the outside plaster skin of a composite wall is NOT turned into the reveal (gs_bAutoTurnIn false) - with it the hole on the facade is 2 cm smaller than the masonry opening on three sides (measured 2026-10-19)

sash_bars.note: horizontal glazing bars per sash: 0 = 'No Grid' (1), 1 = 'Divided' (6) with one bar

bar_h.note: centre of the bar = wall-hole bottom + value (calibrated 0.30 -> bar 5.10..5.18 over hole bottom 4.84)

sidelight.note: Side 1 = the *_right parameters = right of the door seen from outside (wall b->a with reference line Outside, refSide true; checked on the L-shaped wall hole)

transom_h.note: transom zone height from the top of the wall hole (ifc_TransomOffset = hole height - value)

sidelight_w.note: visible sidelight = parameter - gs_frame_width (calibrated: 0.84 -> step at 6.43, 0.94 -> step at 6.33 for s1 = 7.17)

sidelight_sill.note: the wall stays below the sidelight: the hole becomes L-shaped

transom_bars.note: horizontal division of the main transom: 0 = 'No Grid' (1), 1 = 'Divided Frame' (14); the transom accepts 1, 2, 3, 14, 15, 16, 4 - 'Divided' (6) is reset by the parameter script

transom_bar_h.note: height of the division inside the transom above the leaf; position NEOVERENÉ by geometry, checked on the overlay only

transom.note: gs_door_transom exists but the parameter script of the single-leaf part ignores it

transom.unsupported: the parameter script resets gs_transom_height to 0 (tested 2026-10-19); 'Double Door with Transom 27' would carry it, but it exists only through CreateDoors.libraryPartName, whose elements cannot be read or written by Get/SetGDLParametersOfElements (APIERR_GENERAL from ACAPI_LibraryPart_OpenParameters) - Tapir gap T7

leaf_panel.note: panel style of the leaves; allowed 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, 14, 31, 0 (rendered 2026-10-19: 1 horizontal slats, 10-14 raised panels, 14 = big top panel + two narrow middle panels + bottom panel)

transom_h.unsupported: no transom on this part (see fields.transom)
